transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is... my eating has just been all over the place lately. Some weeks I barely touch dinner at all. And then... other nights, I just stand in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone else has gone to bed. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
During those nights when you are eating in the kitchen, do you feel a sense of loss of control, like you can't stop yourself?
Um... no. I don't think so. I just... I'm just eating. It's not really like I can't stop myself, I just... don't.
When you barely eat dinner, is that because you're trying to lose weight or worried about gaining weight?
No... not really. It's not about my weight. I just... I don't know, I just don't really feel like eating those nights, I guess.
How has your mood been lately—have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I go through stretches where... I don't know, the house just feels kind of gray. And heavy. I'll just sit at the kitchen table feeling sort of empty... even though nothing terrible has happened or anything. It's just... yeah.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while, I guess. Those gray periods... where I just feel sort of guilty and lose interest in things... if I add them up, it's been... maybe about seven months. I think.
Before these past seven months, have you ever had times in your life when you felt this down or lost interest in things?

Um... yeah. I mean, if you go back further... I guess it's been happening for a while. Maybe... two years and five months? Around then. That's when... well, that's when the arguments at home started getting worse. About money, and... my art projects. So, yeah, it's been a while.
During these past two-plus years, did you ever have stretches of two months or more where your mood felt completely back to normal?

Um... yeah, I suppose there were times. Maybe a few weeks here and there where... where my mood wasn't really low, but I wasn't feeling high either. Just sort of... in the middle. But... even then, things weren't completely normal. I still... I still knew people online were keeping track of the photos I posted of my garden. And... I'd still hear things. Just brief remarks, when no one else was around. So... not totally normal, no.
